premise: Archaeopteryx wants to fly up to the low branch of the monkey-puzzle tree; twice she flaps, flutters and tumbles into Fern, who giggles, and Stegosaurus says try once more — run first, then flap; the third time she makes it, and Fern misses the tickles.
inspiration: The three-tries pattern of folk tales (the third son succeeds), with the falls soft and funny and a friend's quiet word in between.
lesson: Keep trying, and listen to a friend who believes in you.

en-US.title: Archaeopteryx Tries Again
en-US.text: {fern:enter} {archaeopteryx:enter by hop} {archaeopteryx:go to meadow by hop} Archaeopteryx hopped through the grass and gazed up at the monkey-puzzle tree. {archaeopteryx:face happy} [excited] "Today I'm going to fly all the way up there!" {stegosaurus:enter} Stegosaurus looked up from his lunch. {archaeopteryx:live flap hold} She spread her wings. Flap, flap, flap! Up she went, a little, {archaeopteryx:live flap resume} then down she tumbled, {archaeopteryx:go to fern by hop} {sfx:plop} PLOP, right into Fern. {fern:live laugh} [giggles] "Hee hee! That tickles!" She tried again. {archaeopteryx:hop} Flap, flap, FLAP! A little higher this time… {archaeopteryx:spin} and PLOP, into Fern again. {fern:wobble} {archaeopteryx:face sad} "I can't do it," she sighed. {stegosaurus:go to archaeopteryx} Stegosaurus came over, slow and gentle. "Once more," he said, {stegosaurus:live nod} and nodded. "Run first. Then flap." So she ran, hop, hop, hop, spread her wings wide and flapped with all her might. {sfx:flutter} {archaeopteryx:go to branches} Up, up, up, and onto the branch! {archaeopteryx:face happy} [proudly] {archaeopteryx:live sing} She sang her happiest song. {stegosaurus:face happy} {stegosaurus:hop} Stegosaurus cheered. And down below, {fern:face happy} Fern waved his fronds. "Well done! But come and land on me sometimes. I liked the tickles."

es-ES.title: Arqueoptérix lo vuelve a intentar
es-ES.text: {fern:enter} {archaeopteryx:enter by hop} {archaeopteryx:go to meadow by hop} Arqueoptérix iba dando saltitos por la hierba, mirando la araucaria allá arriba. {archaeopteryx:face happy} [excited] —¡Hoy voy a volar hasta lo más alto! {stegosaurus:enter} Estegosaurio dejó de comer y levantó la cabeza. {archaeopteryx:live flap hold} Ella abrió las alas. ¡Flap, flap, flap! Subió un poquito, {archaeopteryx:live flap resume} y luego bajó dando tumbos {archaeopteryx:go to fern by hop} {sfx:plop} y, ¡PLAF!, aterrizó encima de Helecho. {fern:live laugh} [giggles] —¡Ji, ji! ¡Qué cosquillas! Lo intentó otra vez. {archaeopteryx:hop} ¡Flap, flap, FLAP! Esta vez un poco más alto… {archaeopteryx:spin} y, ¡PLAF!, otra vez encima de Helecho. {fern:wobble} {archaeopteryx:face sad} —No puedo —suspiró. {stegosaurus:go to archaeopteryx} Estegosaurio se acercó, despacito. —Una vez más —le dijo, {stegosaurus:live nod} y asintió—. Primero corre. Luego aletea. Así que corrió, salta que te salta, abrió bien las alas y aleteó con todas sus fuerzas. {sfx:flutter} {archaeopteryx:go to branches} ¡Arriba, arriba, arriba, hasta la rama! {archaeopteryx:face happy} [proudly] {archaeopteryx:live sing} Y cantó su canción más alegre. {stegosaurus:face happy} {stegosaurus:hop} Estegosaurio la vitoreó. Y abajo, {fern:face happy} Helecho agitó sus frondas. —¡Muy bien! Pero ven a aterrizar encima de mí de vez en cuando. Me encantaban las cosquillas.
